status: descriptive profile measurement fixed before computing the new contact/focus/separation metrics
contact: A physical champion is contact-exposed at the end of a round when alive and at Chebyshev distance<=6 from any alive enemy. Omniscient geometry, not a claim about visibility or intent.
damage: Native championDamageDone increment for that round, included in the contact numerator only if the physical champion is contact-exposed at its end. Divide by contact-exposed champion-rounds.
focus: At least two different allied champions issue recorded basic attacks against the same enemy champion in one round. Rate per team-target-round with at least one basic attacker. Casts/AoE/support are omitted.
separation: On consecutive round-end samples, a champion previously alive at<=35% HP with a nearest enemy<=6 moves to a position farther from that enemy's old position. This includes passive displacement and is a kinematic proxy, not true retreat intent.
profile_selection: All five observed Learn opponents plus the three observed Climb opponents with the largest number of our losses, breaking ties by sample count then name.
uncertainty: Game occurrence Wilson95; paired margin mean with map-cluster bootstrap where at least two maps are represented. Small strata and one-sided samples remain descriptive.
limits: No causal exploit or winning policy follows from these profiles; all statistics refer to the frozen historical study, not the current ladder. Final partial rounds are included as one boundary sample.
